findings.description: The check was changed from `isinstance(filename, str)` to `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)`, so a plain `str` is no longer wrapped in a tuple. The check should cover both `str` and `os.PathLike`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `click.edit(filename="file.txt")`. A `str` is not an `os.PathLike`, so it is passed directly to `edit_files` as an iterable of characters. The editor is then launched with one argument per character, such as `f i l e . t x t`, instead of one file. This breaks the most common usage of `filename`.
